items.name: Meta Muse Spark Open
items.summary: Meta open-weighted its flagship Muse Spark model (816B total params, 42B active per token, 1M context) for coding and long-running agentic work — claiming the most capable U.S. open-weight model to date — under the Muse Model License with limited commercial terms.

items.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
items.summary: Open multimodal agent model (120B total, 12B active; text/image/video/doc inputs) targeting always-on enterprise agents under the OpenMDW-1.1 license, with NVIDIA claiming up to 5x throughput vs open peers; a 74B Bolt variant runs local agents on 24GB RTX PCs.

items.name: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Image Klein
items.summary: BFL's most capable open-weight image model to date (5.6B params, FLUX Kommunity License) — frontier-model quality with native 4K, pixel-perfect editing and multi-reference editing, running on consumer GPUs with as little as 8GB VRAM.

items.name: Liquid AI LFM2.5-24B-A2B
items.summary: Liquid AI's efficiency bet — a 24B-total/2B-active MoE (12:1 ratio) aimed at agentic tool-use workloads, reportedly hitting 184 tok/s on an Apple M5 Max; it beats Alibaba's Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on tool use while trailing on SWE-Bench Verified.

items.name: MBZUAI/Inception42 Jais 3 + Jais Speech
items.summary: Arabic-native open model fleet (six models, 900M–375B params, 512K context) adapted from IFM's K2 Horizon, covering Modern Standard Arabic plus Gulf, Levant and North African dialects with agentic tool use, plus a companion Arabic speech-recognition model on Hugging Face.
